newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's cement output rises 6.21 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's cement output rises 6.21 percent in 1996.

text.p: Turkey's total cement production rose by 6.21 percent in 1996 to 35.2 million tonnes, the State Institute of Statistics said on Wednesday.
It said 33.4 million tonnes of the total output was produced by private cement companies in 1996.

The government's contribution to cement production is expected to cease this year after it approves the recent sale to a local investor by the privatisation agency of the last state cement plant to be privatised.
Of the total cement output, 32.1 million tonnes was sold in the domestic market in 1996, a rise of 6.66 percent over the previous year, and 3.1 million tonnes were exported.
